1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000020_RAUBAHN
1.description: And I for one am grateful that they are. I'm told you've been busy since our paths last crossed at the Ghimlyt Dark.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000030_RAUBAHN
2.description: Not that I understand half of it. When the Scions spoke of other worlds, I'd struggle to describe what I pictured.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000040_RAUBAHN
3.description: Mayhap things would seem clearer were I to hear the tale from your own lips, but I'm afraid the situation will not afford us that luxury.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000050_RAUBAHN
4.description: I trust you two require no introduction.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000060_SHADOWHUNTER
5.description: We meet again, hero of Eorzea.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000070_SHADOWHUNTER
6.description: Must we repeat this ridiculous display? I pose no threat to you─though what I come to warn you of very well might.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000080_RAUBAHN
7.description: Had he meant to do us harm, I hazard he would have kept to the shadows─and brought more than two companions.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000090_RAUBAHN
8.description: We need not pretend to be the best of friends, but I hope we can put aside our differences for the present.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000100_SHADOWHUNTER
9.description: As you are doubtless aware, Ser Estinien and I cooperated to rid the world of Black Rose in your absence.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000110_SHADOWHUNTER
10.description: Our journey together took us as far as the imperial palace, where we witnessed Emperor Varis meet his death at Zenos's hand.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000120_SHADOWHUNTER
11.description: Being the sole witnesses to this crime, and in no position to defend our innocence, we were then forced to flee, each pursuing his own avenue of escape.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000130_SHADOWHUNTER
12.description: When we were later reunited, Estinien claimed to have encountered an unfamiliar kind of machina during his flight. But to me, his description seemed anything but. And upon further investigation, I found that I was right.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000140_SHADOWHUNTER
13.description: The Empire is developing a new Ultima Weapon.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000150_KRILE
14.description: What? That Allagan monstrosity? Created to vanquish primals? ...With which you yourself once thought to conquer Eorzea?

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000160_SHADOWHUNTER
15.description: The same. In my foolishness, I sought to harness its power─and became the Ascians' pawn in so doing.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000161_SHADOWHUNTER
16.description: But you know as well as I how that tale ended.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000170_SHADOWHUNTER
17.description: The Weapon itself, excavated from beneath this very city, was destroyed ere we could fully unravel its secrets. And that should have been the end of it.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000180_SHADOWHUNTER
18.description: But, unlikely as it sounds, the Empire's efforts to recreate it have somehow borne fruit─primarily through secret research conducted by the VIIth Imperial Legion, it would seem.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000190_KRILE
19.description: Wait. The VIIth was all but annihilated at Carteneau─along with its legatus.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000200_SHADOWHUNTER
20.description: Indeed, few survived. The VIIth as it is now has little in common with the legion led by van Darnus, and its leadership has changed hands several times since.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000210_SHADOWHUNTER
21.description: Precisely how this project has continued despite such turmoil, and under whose auspices, remains a mystery.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000220_SHADOWHUNTER
22.description: What we do know, however, is that a number of prototypes have been produced...and that one of them is on its way to Eorzea.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000230_SHADOWHUNTER
23.description: We attempted to stop it, but it was all we could do to slow its progress. So we resolved instead to bring you warning.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000240_MAXIMA
24.description: And right glad are we that you did─though it soundly dashed our hopes that tensions might ease at last...

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000250_RAUBAHN
25.description: As it is, we've begun to strengthen our presence in the Ghimlyt Dark, and are assembling a force to meet the coming threat. A force with you in its vanguard, I hope.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000260_RAUBAHN
26.description: Before you say anything, I know full well you have pressing concerns of your own. Your comrades remain in peril, and I would not ask you to forsake them.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000270_RAUBAHN
27.description: But the fact remains that you and you alone have faced the Ultima Weapon and emerged victorious. We need you.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000280_RAUBAHN
28.description: And so, when the time comes─<hex:021A020203>if<hex:021A020103> your comrades can spare you─I bid you lend us your strength. I've assigned an officer to await your word.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000290_SHADOWHUNTER
29.description: The Ascians' downfall was to be the work of my remaining days...but it was my hand that kindled these flames, and I cannot allow them to spread any further.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000300_SHADOWHUNTER
30.description: I will do what I must to see this mistake consigned to history once and for all...even if it means begging your aid. The fates will enjoy the irony, even as I endure the ignominy.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000310_MAXIMA
31.description: I too shall make for the border and offer my skills, meager though they seem in such company. Mayhap we shall meet there anon.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000320_KRILE
32.description: Though we can ill afford to ignore the coming of a new Ultima Weapon, our friends' plight grows ever more precarious, and none save you can join them in the First.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000330_KRILE
33.description: I only hope you are not forced to make a choice...

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000340_MYSTERYVOICE
34.description: Now that we're all here─what news from the Source?

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000350_MYSTERYVOICE
35.description: Now that we're all here─what news from the Source?

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000360_ALPHINAUD
36.description: A new <hex:021A020203>Ultima Weapon<hex:021A020103>...? We must count ourselves lucky that Gaius has pledged his assistance.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000370_YSHTOLA
37.description: While this is indeed a worrying development, I think the state of the Empire as a whole greater grounds for concern.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000380_YSHTOLA
38.description: With the Emperor slain and Zenos returned, it is impossible to predict how matters will unfold in Garlemald. The Ultima Weapon may be but the first of many unpleasant surprises.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000390_URIANGER
39.description: The situation beareth closer observation, of that there is no doubt─and doth compound our need to return unto the Source.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000400_MYSTERYVOICE
40.description: Then let us address that issue. Our long search for a means to see you safely home may well be nearing its conclusion.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000410_MYSTERYVOICE
41.description: Thanks in large part to Urianger and Beq Lugg's invaluable insight, we have succeeded in fashioning a vessel for the journey.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000420_BEQLUGG
42.description: We set out to create a crystalline container retaining the more useful properties of white auracite, but without its regrettable limitations. And after a good deal of trial and error, we made one.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000430_BEQLUGG
43.description: An ark for soul and mind both, that will allow your incorporeal self in its entirety to be ferried between worlds... A “spirit vessel,” if you will.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000460_URIANGER
46.description: Though the vessel is possessed of the requisite qualities to hold mind and memory, it wanteth yet for a means to <hex:021A020203>receive<hex:021A020103> of them. For that, we must needs imbue it with the Exarch's innate gift.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000470_YSHTOLA
47.description: A gift that lives on only through the blood of the Allagan emperors...which certainly does not flow within auracite, or any other crystal.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000480_URIANGER
48.description: Just so, milady. The blood serveth as a conduit of sorts─in its absence, memory cannot pass from mind unto mind, nor from flesh unto crystal.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000490_MYSTERYVOICE
49.description: That being the case, we must either alter the process of inheritance so as to require no such thing, or determine a means by which my blood may permeate the vessel.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000500_MYSTERYVOICE
50.description: I am hopeful that the records found within this tower will yield the knowledge we require to pursue one or the other of these avenues.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000510_BEQLUGG
51.description: As well you should be! The Allagans' body of aetherological research is extraordinary. I can scarce believe it the work of ages past.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000520_BEQLUGG
52.description: But its underlying principles are not so very different from those of my own field of study. Given time, we will find the answers we seek.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000530_MYSTERYVOICE
53.description: I know that you can ill afford to wait, and it pains me that I must ask you to do so. I can only reaffirm my promise to you that a solution will be found.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000540_MYSTERYVOICE
54.description: Whatever it takes, I <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> see you safely home.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000560_MYSTERYVOICE
56.description: I do hope you haven't come to tell us that mortal peril fast approaches.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000570_LYNA
57.description: No. I had hoped to speak with the Warrior of Darkness.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000580_LYNA
58.description: But there is no need to cut short your meeting on my account. I will be waiting outside.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000590_MYSTERYVOICE
59.description: Why not speak in here─she knows I don't mind. Unless she didn't want to...

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000600_ALPHINAUD
60.description: Perhaps I might accompany you? Though I am woefully ill-qualified to assist in the Exarch's research, I may yet be of some use to Lyna.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000610_LYNA
61.description: Did you slay this eater? Your orders were to await the main force before engaging.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000620_RESOLUTESOLDIER
62.description: No, Captain! It wasn't us, I swear it! A man came out of nowhere and cut it down before we knew what was happening.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000630_LYNA
63.description: By himself? Certainly it is no Lightwarden, but nevertheless...

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000640_BRAVESOLDIER
64.description: (-Gallant Guardsman-)It's true! Felled it with a single swing of his axe, he did! Never seen anything like it!

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000650_BRAVESOLDIER
65.description: (-Gallant Guardsman-)So I says to him, “Who are you, the Warrior of bleedin' Darkness!?”

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000660_BRAVESOLDIER
66.description: (-Gallant Guardsman-)And he says, “No, I'm a Warrior of Light.” And that was it. Buggered off as quick as he came.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000680_SOLDIER03608
68.description: Why would someone go around calling himself that, though? It was those bastards who caused the Flood.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000690_SOLDIER03608
69.description: I mean, if you were going to pretend to be anyone, it'd be <hex:021A020203><hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03><hex:021A020103>─the Warrior of Darkness!

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000700_BRAVESOLDIER
70.description: (-Gallant Guardsman-)Eh? Oh! I─ I didn't know! It's an honor!

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000710_LYNA
71.description: Since the eater is no longer a threat, our work here is done. Return to your posts.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000720_SOLDIER03608
72.description: I had hoped to fight at your side today... But I'll continue to follow your example─and may we meet again!

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000730_LYNA
73.description: I apologize for the wasted journey. It seems I overestimated the threat.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000740_LYNA
74.description: As for this “Warrior of Light”... I do not know who would be brazen enough to take that mantle for his own. Whatever it may once have meant, it is forever tainted by the association with the Flood.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000750_LYNA
75.description: The Exarch told me the truth of Ardbert and his comrades' deeds, and I am aware they played some part in your own triumph. But to most, they are synonymous with the calamity that befell this world.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000760_LYNA
76.description: Still, if this man is minded to destroy sin eaters, I may forgive him his unfortunate choice of alias.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000770_LYNA
77.description: But that is neither here nor there. I thank you for accompanying me.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000780_ALPHINAUD
78.description: With that concluded, shall we return to the Crystarium? There is a proposal I should like to make...

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000790_LYNA
79.description: Forgive me. There is one more thing.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000800_LYNA
80.description: A personal concern of mine. I had hoped you might have a moment to speak privately.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000810_ALPHINAUD
81.description: Take your time. I shall go on ahead.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000820_LYNA
82.description: I will not mince words. This matter concerns the Exarch.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000830_LYNA
83.description: Though his countenance belies his age, his demeanor never has. He has seen more than any man should, and grown ever more weary with time...

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000840_LYNA
84.description: But I see I give the wrong impression. While it is true he attempted to open a letter with his salmon fillet the other evening, we are not here because I suspect his mind is deteriorating.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000850_LYNA
85.description: Nor do I believe him to be so maddeningly unconcerned by the prospect of his own death as he once was. Indeed, the opposite is true.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000860_LYNA
86.description: It is for this reason that I seek your advice.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000870_LYNA
87.description: Since he returned from the Tempest, the Exarch is...not as he was.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000880_LYNA
88.description: He seems a different man. A <hex:021A020203>younger<hex:021A020103> man.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000890_LYNA
89.description: I know not the details of his research, but when I saw him at work recently, there was a glint in his eye that I had never seen before. He looked <hex:021A020203>happy<hex:021A020103>.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000900_LYNA
90.description: It was as if he had peered into the future, and for the first time, found joy there.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000910_LYNA
91.description: Though it gladdens me to see him thus, I wonder if I should not keep my distance. I fear that my presence will only anchor him to the past. Remind him of all the pain that came before.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
93.description: Anchors keep us where we have chosen to be.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
94.description: He's lost without you, you know. And he misses you already.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000940_LYNA
97.description: Then perhaps we might remain as we were. As we have always been.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000960_LYNA
99.description: In that case, I will have to speak with him about the amount of time he is spending at work.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000970_LYNA
100.description: This research is important, I know, but if he refuses to consider his own health, I will have to consider it for him.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000980_ALPHINAUD
101.description: Yes, this looks to be nearly everyone. Let us begin, shall we?

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_000990_ALPHINAUD
102.description: Though I am usually the first to hold forth at such events, I think, on this occasion, that honor should fall to you.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001000_YSHTOLA
103.description: They <hex:021A020203>would<hex:021A020103> be more inclined to take the word of the Warrior of Darkness.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001010_URIANGER
104.description: Indeed. In light of the subject matter, who better than thee to speak these truths?

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001020_SOLDIER03608
105.description: Wicked white... The Warriors of Light did all that?

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001030_BRAVESOLDIER
106.description: (-Gallant Guardsman-)So they never─ I mean, they only ever wanted to help? And when everything they'd done turned to ash, they <hex:021A020203>still<hex:021A020103> carried on...

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001040_SOLDIER03608
107.description: They gave everything to stop the Flood... First their lives, then their souls...

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001050_SOLDIER03608
108.description: And they managed it, too─in the end. They <hex:021A020203>saved<hex:021A020103> us. And we cursed their names.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001060_ALPHINAUD
109.description: This should go a long way towards clearing the air.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
113.description: I take it I'm not imagining this, then.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001080_ALPHINAUD
114.description: I definitely see <hex:021A020203>something<hex:021A020103>. You don't think it's a ghost, do you?

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001090_URIANGER
115.description: Nay. Yonder standeth no bloodless apparition, but a Warrior of Light and Darkness both. Ardbert.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001110_BRAVESOLDIER
117.description: (-Gallant Guardsman-)It's you! The one who slew the eater...

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001120_DUMMYARDBERT
118.description: (-Ardbert-)That it should be the Warrior of Darkness who brought the truth to light... You've saved me a fair bit of time─though I have a few words of my own to say, if I may.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001130_DUMMYARDBERT
119.description: (-Ardbert-)People of the Crystarium! I am Ardbert, one of those you know as a Warrior of Light.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001140_SOLDIER03608
120.description: That's impossible! You should be dead...

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001150_DUMMYARDBERT
121.description: (-Ardbert-)Aye, that I should. But as the world has been given new life, so too have I.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001160_DUMMYARDBERT
122.description: (-Ardbert-)I know not why I, and I alone, have been gifted this chance. But I do know this: only by the will of the star itself could such a miracle come to pass.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001170_DUMMYARDBERT
123.description: (-Ardbert-)The hero who stands before you now─the Warrior of Darkness─is not of this world. And the day will come when <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> must return to <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> home.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001180_DUMMYARDBERT
124.description: (-Ardbert-)But this land is <hex:021A020203>our<hex:021A020103> home. And if it is to remain so, now and forevermore, it is <hex:021A020203>we<hex:021A020103> who must protect it.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001190_DUMMYARDBERT
125.description: (-Ardbert-)The time to rely on saviors from afar has passed. It is <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> who must rise. <hex:021A020203>You<hex:021A020103> who must become the new Warriors of Light!

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001210_DUMMYARDBERT
127.description: (-Ardbert-)None of us were born heroes, my friend. I was only ever a man with a thirst for adventure.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001220_DUMMYARDBERT
128.description: (-Ardbert-)But wherever my journeys took me, I was invariably confronted with the same choice: to lend what aid I could to those in need─or not. And I always chose the former.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001230_DUMMYARDBERT
129.description: (-Ardbert-)Any one of you could do the same. All you need is the will to help your fellow man, and the resolve to see it through.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001240_URIANGER
130.description: From thine own lips did we learn of Ardbert's fate, and by thy countenance, I gather thou art not inclined to recant thy testimony.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001250_URIANGER
131.description: Yet whosoever this man may be, his words hold truth─and resonate with the citizenry besides. For us to voice our doubts here and now would serve but to sow disquiet. 'Twere better we retired unto the Ocular, and there discussed this matter in private.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001260_ALPHINAUD
132.description: Go. I will stay here and watch.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001270_MYSTERYVOICE
133.description: So that is a Warrior of Light of the First.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001271_MYSTERYVOICE
134.description: I have not had the pleasure of making his acquaintance, but as you all seem to be in agreement, I gather this is no simple case of mistaken identity.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001280_BEQLUGG
135.description: As far as I was able to discern, that was indeed Ardbert. It has been a long time, but not that long. Could he truly have been resurrected as he claims?

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
138.description: It looks like him and sounds like him. But it <hex:021A020203>isn't<hex:021A020103> him.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001290_URIANGER
139.description: Ardbert did entrust his very soul unto thee. I see no reason to question thy judgment.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001300_YSHTOLA
140.description: Nor I. To my eyes, your aether burns as brightly as the day you slew Emet-Selch. That is proof that he is with you still.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001310_URIANGER
141.description: Yet that which standeth now before the people is far more than a passing imitation. I am reminded of the Cardinal Virtues...though a sin eater he is not.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001320_URIANGER
142.description: Which leaveth but one plausible explanation.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001340_MYSTERYVOICE
144.description: Given their fondness for posthumous possession, I would have to agree.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001350_MYSTERYVOICE
145.description: From what I understand, the Warriors of Light were laid to rest in Eulmore by those whom they had aided in life. At the time, some few still remembered them as heroes.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001360_MYSTERYVOICE
146.description: Needless to say, four of them were subsequently exhumed to serve as the Virtues. And if one knew where to look, Ardbert too would not have been difficult to find.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001370_YSHTOLA
147.description: Assuming then that this is indeed the work of an Ascian, my mind inevitably turns to the last remaining Paragon to survive the sundering...

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001390_URIANGER
149.description: That Zenos hath reclaimed his own flesh is known.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001400_URIANGER
150.description: Thus evicted from his borrowed form...and cognizant, no doubt, of Emet-Selch's failure here in the First...

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001410_URIANGER
151.description: 'Tis quite possible the emissary chose Ardbert for his next vessel.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001420_BEQLUGG
152.description: Inhabiting the flesh of the fallen... My, that is unsavory. And they do this often, you say?

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001430_URIANGER
153.description: Verily, for they possess no corporeal forms of their own. In what one may term their natural state, none save those gifted with the Echo can perceive them.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001440_URIANGER
154.description: Indeed, when Elidibus intruded upon the Waking Sands, his presence did go unmarked by all save Minfilia and the Warrior of Light.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001450_URIANGER
155.description: On that occasion, I myself remained ignorant of his coming until after his departure.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001460_URIANGER
156.description: 'Twas only at a later juncture, when he deigned to appear before me in borrowed flesh that I was finally able to take the measure of him.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001470_URIANGER
157.description: In such puppetry do the Ascians engage when they seek to influence the course of history.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001480_YSHTOLA
158.description: And they have gained much by it. Emet-Selch single-handedly built the Garlean Empire in this manner, while Lahabrea came close to conquering Eorzea having taken possession of Thancred's living body.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001490_URIANGER
159.description: Yet it must needs be noted that the Ascians cannot avail themselves of <hex:021A020203>all<hex:021A020103> mortal vessels. For were they able to do so, none would serve as a better pawn than our own redoubtable champion.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001500_URIANGER
160.description: Mayhap the blessing of Light shieldeth Hydaelyn's chosen from Ascian influence. Or mayhap other forces are at work. We cannot say for certain.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001510_MYSTERYVOICE
161.description: Whatever the reason, I hope it holds true. I dare not contemplate what might come to pass otherwise.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001520_YSHTOLA
162.description: Is it not peculiar, then, that Ardbert's mortal remains should be susceptible, given that he was once a Warrior of Light? Or did the final departure of his soul make it possible, perhaps?

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001530_YSHTOLA
163.description: Regardless, to hear an Ascian use him to call forth new Warriors of Light boggles the mind.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001540_URIANGER
164.description: Elidibus hath ever been an enigma, his ostensible purpose being to preserve the balance between Light and Dark.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001550_URIANGER
165.description: When he made overtures towards me, however, I was afforded a glimpse behind the mask of the self-appointed emissary.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001560_URIANGER
166.description: I shall not defend mine actions, undertaken in pursuit of a better understanding of our foe, as either wise or prudent.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001570_URIANGER
167.description: Nevertheless, what little I did glean may now prove useful.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001580_URIANGER
168.description: Elidibus possesseth a subtle mind, practiced in the art of manipulation. That he coaxed this star's most valiant heroes as far as the Source with naught save half-truths is no trifling feat.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001590_URIANGER
169.description: And now, I believe, he doth employ his skills once more to some as-yet-unknown end. Though naught is certain, should my suspicions prove true, we shall have need of all our wits if we are to uncover─and thereafter thwart─his plot.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001600_MYSTERYVOICE
170.description: Agreed. 'Tis plain that simply speaking out against him will not avail us. At best, it would only serve to confuse the people.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001610_MYSTERYVOICE
171.description: And I would hesitate to do anything which might tarnish Ardbert's reputation once more, nor yours by association.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001620_MYSTERYVOICE
172.description: That being the case, it may be wise to keep a covert eye on this “Ardbert's” movements as we attempt to discern his purpose and how best to mitigate his influence.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001630_BEQLUGG
173.description: His performance appears to have concluded. What now─go back out and follow him?

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001640_URIANGER
174.description: 'Twould appear Master Alphinaud already hath pursuit in mind, and I suspect one pair of eyes shall better serve our cause than half a dozen. Let the rest of us maintain an inconspicuous distance─for the present, at least.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001650_ALMET
175.description: Come. Our new discoveries are to be found this way.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001660_YSHTOLA
176.description: The people of Ronka are known to have venerated animals, but these features do not match those of any indigenous species. This is no common beast.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001670_YSHTOLA
177.description: Though that much is plain from its proportions.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001680_CYMET
178.description: Lifelike, is it not? One could almost imagine it breathed.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001720_YSHTOLA
183.description: This owl, by contrast, seems no different from the others we've seen.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001740_ALMET
185.description: As you see, one statue is missing. I expect we are meant to replace it, as before.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001750_YSHTOLA
186.description: Too simple. There will be some additional defense mechanism.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001760_YSHTOLA
187.description: Just a moment─there are words carved into the stone.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001770_YSHTOLA
188.description: He...who would disturb...a hero's deserved slumber...

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001780_YSHTOLA
189.description: Shall instead...waken the beast...and know...his folly...

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001800_UIMET
191.description: Wh-What? But I only─ What is happening!?

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001810_CYMET
192.description: Oh no... Oh no, no, no... I-It lives!

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001820_YSHTOLA
193.description: Why am I not surprised? Prepare yourselves!

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001830_YSHTOLA
194.description: 'Twould seem the magicks have returned us. How polite.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001850_UIMET
196.description: Oh, we were bound to run into a living statue eventually. And now we can open the door!

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001860_YSHTOLA
197.description: “He who would disturb a hero's deserved slumber...”

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001870_YSHTOLA
198.description: A tomb, just as I thought. Befitting a hero.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001880_ALMET
199.description: She is Viis! Could it be the archmage Tiuna?

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001890_ALMET
200.description: A legendary hero of Ronka, as you surmised. The tales tell of how she smote entire armies with a single incantation, so potent was her spellcraft─though she ever fought in the name of peace.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001900_UIMET
201.description: I thought them no more than tales. To think she really existed...

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001910_CYMET
202.description: Well, I for one always believed!

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001930_YSHTOLA
204.description: By the light...of fallen stars...great power awakens...

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001940_ALMET
205.description: Tiuna was not only a master of spellcraft. It is said she could see truths long lost and hear the voices of men's hearts.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001960_YSHTOLA
207.description: In which case...none of this is mere coincidence.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001970_YSHTOLA
208.description: A shower of stars setting the sky aflame─and in both this world and the Source, we find individuals within whom a mysterious power awakened at the sight.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001980_YSHTOLA
209.description: We could never unpick the why of it. Now, however...I believe we might.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_001990_YSHTOLA
210.description: Does the scene depicted here not resemble the one we saw when we first ventured into the Qitana Ravel?

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002000_YSHTOLA
211.description: Moreover, does it not recall that which Emet-Selch invited us to witness in Amaurot?

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002020_YSHTOLA
213.description: If, as the Exarch's research suggests, soul and mind share a fragile yet profound bond, might it not be possible for an event to leave such a deep imprint upon the soul that it could be perceived eons later─given a suitable trigger?

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002030_YSHTOLA
214.description: The Echo defies explanation by conventional aetherological theory. Or shall we say, modern aetherological theory.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002040_YSHTOLA
215.description: But if it is a power that once belonged to the ancients, to souls yet undivided...

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002050_YSHTOLA
217.description: It would seem I have entered the realm of pure speculation. And I call myself a scholar.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002060_YSHTOLA
218.description: I shall refrain from making any further wild claims until such time as I have evidence.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002070_YSHTOLA
219.description: Still, I cannot choose but be reminded of our experience in Amaurot...

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
221.description: Then you must recall Emet-Selch's dying request.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
222.description: I will not soon forget it.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002100_ALMET
225.description: We have always protected the tales of Ronka, just as we have protected this place. But we are mindful of what our mothers taught us.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002110_ALMET
226.description: We see the past through our own eyes, and speak of it with our own words. Thus do we come to understand it, in our own way. But this is not the same as remembering.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002130_YSHTOLA
228.description: Though we witnessed the Final Days, our impressions could not fail to be colored by our own experiences and expectations. Those who lived through it would have perceived the event quite differently.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002140_YSHTOLA
229.description: We must bear in mind that it is no simple matter to keep the truth alive, or it will die with Emet-Selch and his kin.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002150_YSHTOLA
230.description: But we have disturbed Tiuna long enough. Fanow will serve similarly well as a venue for our contemplations.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002160_THANCRED
231.description: If you were hoping to vent your frustrations on our eater friend here, I can only apologize.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002170_RYNE
232.description: Few as they are now, it took us no time at all to track it down.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002180_ALPHINAUD
233.description: That suits our purpose perfectly. Now we need only wait for Ardbert to arrive.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002190_ALISAIE
234.description: Weren't you two meant to be attending to the Empty?

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002200_THANCRED
235.description: We were, and are. But we can hardly ignore the rest of the world, so we thought we might see how things were coming along. From what we can gather, the answer is “strangely.”

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002210_THANCRED
236.description: We were indeed, and we've made a certain amount of progress. So we thought we might see how the rest of the world was getting on. From what we can gather, the answer is “strangely.”

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002220_RYNE
237.description: Right now, we think we can do more good here.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002230_YSHTOLA
238.description: It is heartening to have all present.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002240_ALPHINAUD
239.description: Indeed! We will be glad of the additional hands should matters escalate.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002260_DUMMYARDBERT
241.description: (-Ardbert-)Hah. It seems I've lost this particular race.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002270_DUMMYARDBERT
242.description: (-Ardbert-)Ah, though I suppose it's only fair.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002280_DUMMYARDBERT
243.description: (-Ardbert-)When we first met, it was I who outpaced you. Ravana, was it?

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002290_DUMMYARDBERT
244.description: (-Ardbert-)But where are my manners? I wouldn't be here were it not for you, and I have yet to say a word of thanks!

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
247.description: Ask whether he wishes Seto were here.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002300_DUMMYARDBERT
248.description: (-Ardbert-)Arm giving you trouble? You should have it examined.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002310_DUMMYARDBERT
249.description: (-Ardbert-)Poor fellow. He will be sorely missed.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_A6_000_002_NONE_VOICE
252.description: I thought you were supposed to be good at this.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002320_DUMMYARDBERT
253.description: (-“Ardbert”-)Very well. Let us forgo this pretense.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002330_ELIDIBUS
254.description: (-“Ardbert”-)Very well. Let us forgo this pretense.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002340_DUMMYARDBERT
255.description: (-“Ardbert”-)After all, it was never you that I needed to deceive.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002350_ELIDIBUS
256.description: (-“Ardbert”-)After all, it was never you that I needed to deceive.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002370_ELIDIBUS
258.description: Through your time in Emet-Selch's imitation of our home, I daresay you have gained a better understanding of my role since last we met. Not that it matters.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002380_ALPHINAUD
259.description: We understand your role, Emissary, but not your goal. What is it that you seek to achieve?

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002390_ELIDIBUS
260.description: I seek to enact the will of the Convocation, of course. If it helps you to think of me as but another Ascian, no different in nature or purpose from the rest, you are welcome to do so.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002400_ALPHINAUD
261.description: Once, I would have said your goal was destruction alone.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002410_ALPHINAUD
262.description: Now I understand that you fight for something you love, just as we do.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002420_ALPHINAUD
263.description: Yet though we seem doomed to clash, I bid you consider Emet-Selch's final words.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002430_ALPHINAUD
264.description: “Remember that we once lived,” he said. Had he not seen some glimmer of hope in our kind, I do not believe he would have spoken thus.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002440_ALPHINAUD
265.description: “Remember that we once lived,” he said. Had he not seen some glimmer of hope in our kind, I do not believe he would have spoken thus.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002450_YSHTOLA
266.description: None better understood your plight than he. His words must surely be worthy of your consideration.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002470_ELIDIBUS
268.description: How very unlike you, to err so gravely.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002480_ELIDIBUS
269.description: That one should stray at the end of so onerous a path is understandable, but I had thought you above such weakness. Mayhap you thought the same. Would that I had been present to offer correction...

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002490_ELIDIBUS
270.description: But I shall do so now, as is my duty, and return all to its proper course.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002500_ELIDIBUS
271.description: As for you... Look at yourselves. Look at your <hex:021A020203>history<hex:021A020103>. Look back one hundred short years, to how your greatest warriors were undone.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002510_ELIDIBUS
272.description: And now? At but a word from me, you raise your hands in answer like the puppets you are.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002520_ELIDIBUS
274.description: You fail and you fail and you learn nothing─allow that which is most important to slip through your fumbling fingers like so many grains of sand. Again and again and <hex:021A020203>again<hex:021A020103>. And you would remember <hex:021A020203>us<hex:021A020103>? You do forget yourselves.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002530_ELIDIBUS
275.description: There is no common ground to be found between you and I. Nor do I require any.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002560_ALPHINAUD
278.description: Well...we have confirmed the identity of our foe, at least. And 'tis safe to say his objective is the Rejoining.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002570_ALISAIE
279.description: But we still have no idea how playing the part of a Warrior of Light will further his cause, nor why he would spur others to do the same.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002580_YSHTOLA
280.description: Another visit to the Tempest may shed some light upon these mysteries.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002590_YSHTOLA
281.description: Whether we are to exchange words or blows with Elidibus at our next meeting, the fact remains: we know too little.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002600_YSHTOLA
282.description: Ere our paths cross again, I would learn more of the world that once was─and of Elidibus himself.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002610_YSHTOLA
283.description: In this, we would be best served going directly to his home, much as Emet-Selch came to ours.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002620_URIANGER
284.description: Though I see the wisdom in thy suggestion, the Amaurot we visited is but a phantom born of Emet-Selch's memory. I fear it will teach us little that we do not already know.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002630_YSHTOLA
285.description: I quite agree. Yet the ruins of the actual city remain unexplored.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002640_YSHTOLA
286.description: Given the vastness of the Tempest, I should not be surprised were there more such structures like to those in which the Ondo reside.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_A7_000_001_NONE_VOICE
288.description: If there's aught to be learned, I want to know.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
289.description: For want of a better option...

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_A7_000_003_NONE_VOICE
290.description: As long as you don't make me do any more chores.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002660_YSHTOLA
292.description: Mayhap your skepticism will leaven my curiosity.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002670_YSHTOLA
293.description: Keep that up and I'll send you to bed without supper.

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002680_ALPHINAUD
294.description: Assuming we are all in agreement, then, I suggest we first pay a visit to the Ondo. If anyone can tell us where more ruins are to be found, it is them.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002690_YSHTOLA
295.description: This structure must have served an important function. And here are yet more crystals...

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002700_ALPHINAUD
296.description: I too noted the crystal repository on the way. The benthos seem to employ them in their spellcasting.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002710_URIANGER
297.description: In such vessels did the ancients preserve concepts─ideal forms to be drawn upon in the act of creation.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002720_URIANGER
298.description: That so great an abundance should reside here lendeth credence to Y'shtola's conclusion. This facility held great significance.

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002730_ANCIENTSA
299.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Thank you all for joining us at Anyder in these most perilous of times.<hex:0248020103>

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002740_ANCIENTSA
300.description: <hex:024804F2022303>By the summoning of Zodiark have we been granted a reprieve. Yet immutable as the laws He has woven may seem, they will not serve to forestall our doom.<hex:0248020103>

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002750_ANCIENTSB
301.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Nay. Should we continue down this path, our fate will be the same.<hex:0248020103>

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002760_ANCIENTSB
302.description: <hex:024804F2022303>I said as much to the Convocation, of course, but the stubborn fools turned a deaf ear to my warnings.<hex:0248020103>

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002770_ANCIENTSB
303.description: <hex:024804F2022303>I had hoped that the defector, at least, would side with us, but I regret to report our overtures have gone unanswered.<hex:0248020103>

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002780_ANCIENTSB
304.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Whither tend your thoughts, Venat? Where you lead, we will follow.<hex:0248020103>

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002790_VENAS
305.description: <hex:024804F2022303>I shall not speak ill of the Convocation─they too seek only to secure the future of our star.<hex:0248020103>

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002800_VENAS
306.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Yet it is plain they will not countenance a permanent solution. That being the case, we must ask ourselves a simple question: are we prepared to pursue our chosen course, even should it mean suffering the eternal condemnation of our brethren?<hex:0248020103>

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002810_VENAS
307.description: <hex:024804F2022303>If so, I see no further reason to demur.<hex:0248020103>

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002820_VENAS
308.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Let us bring forth the Light that shall ever after keep the Darkness in check.<hex:0248020103>

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002830_YSHTOLA
309.description: So...it was they who first summoned Hydaelyn.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002840_ALPHINAUD
310.description: Their discussion did seem to imply as much, yes. I cannot say I have ever heard of this “Venat” before.

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002850_URIANGER
311.description: For a certainty, Emet-Selch never uttered the name, speak though he did of the schism which Zodiark's advent wrought upon mankind.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002860_URIANGER
312.description: Some were of the viewpoint that His power must needs be restrained, and to that end did they call forth She who would serve as His shackles.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002870_URIANGER
313.description: We know now that it was this Venat to whom they looked for leadership.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002880_YSHTOLA
314.description: And that this place, in all likelihood, served as their headquarters. The presence of such intimate records attests to that.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002890_YSHTOLA
315.description: I would hear what else they have to tell us. All of it. Did anyone see the source of the image?

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002900_YSHTOLA
316.description: The device there? Then let us see what other secrets it holds.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002910_ANCIENTSA
317.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Venat, please... Why must it be you?<hex:0248020103>

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002920_ANCIENTSA
318.description: <hex:024804F2022303>If I may speak plainly, I would sooner it were another─<hex:021A020203>any<hex:021A020103> other. You are our <hex:021A020203>leader<hex:021A020103>. None can take your place.<hex:0248020103>

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002930_VENAS
319.description: <hex:024804F2022303>You know as well as I that but few support our cause. Far fewer than they who place their faith in Zodiark.<hex:0248020103>

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002940_VENAS
320.description: <hex:024804F2022303>If Hydaelyn is to stand a chance of opposing Him, I am the only one who might suffice as Her heart.<hex:0248020103>

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002950_VENAS
321.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Rest assured, however: I shall not vanish from this world. The form I take shall ever remain my choice.<hex:0248020103>

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002960_ANCIENTSA
322.description: <hex:024804F2022303>...Then I will press you no more. Only know this...you will be sorely missed.<hex:0248020103>

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002970_ANCIENTSA
323.description: <hex:024804F2022303>I wonder...is this how the Convocation felt about Elidibus?<hex:0248020103>

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_002990_YSHTOLA
325.description: Forgive me, but did that not strongly imply that Elidibus sacrificed himself to become Zodiark's heart?

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003000_ALISAIE
326.description: Seven hells... Then who─or <hex:021A020203>what<hex:021A020103>─are we dealing with?

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003010_ALPHINAUD
327.description: Dare I ask what's going on?

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003020_MYSTERYVOICE
328.description: Ah, excellent timing. For me, in any case. We have a problem.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003030_MYSTERYVOICE
329.description: The vast majority of those gathered here are presently in the employ of the guard or else one of the facets...and no longer wish to be so.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003040_MYSTERYVOICE
330.description: In principle, all are free to change vocation at any time─but a city does require a certain number of people in these positions if it is to continue to function. For the moment, I have asked them to postpone their resignation until such time as replacements can be found.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003050_MYSTERYVOICE
331.description: As you may have surmised, we have the “Warrior of Light” to thank for this...

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003060_BRAVESOLDIER
332.description: It's you! The Warrior of Darkness!

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003080_BRAVESOLDIER
334.description: Someone's going to have to look after this place once you're gone. We just want to be ready to do our bit when the time comes.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003090_SOLDIER03608
335.description: And not only here, but everywhere! Which is why we've got to get out there, and lend a hand to those in need.

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003100_SOLDIER03608
336.description: That's what you did, isn't it? Even if it was just little things, at the start. You helped people.

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003110_SOLDIER03608
341.description: And we're trying to do the same! We may have our sky back, but there's no shortage of people who still need help.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003120_SOLDIER03608
342.description: Strong and silent─just as a hero should be! You let your actions speak for you, and we mean to do the same. We might have our sky back, but there are still people who need help.

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003130_SOLDIER03608
343.description: If we follow in your footsteps, then I choose to believe we too can be heroes one day. Even Warriors of Light.

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003140_ALPHINAUD
344.description: What are we to say to that? We can hardly tell them they are mistaken.

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003150_ALPHINAUD
345.description: They seek but to do good, as you have.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003160_URIANGER
346.description: But no more can we stand idly by and suffer a Paragon's scheme to proceed unchallenged.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003240_BRAVESOLDIER
355.description: You and all? Then why does it feel like it's inside my head!?

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003280_DUMMYARDBERT
359.description: (-???-)Did I not tell you, my friends!? You are Warriors of Light!

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003300_DUMMYARDBERT
361.description: What you hear is the voice of Light itself, and it has blessed you with its power. Welcome to the fold!

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003360_ALPHINAUD
367.description: The falling stars─were they your doing? And why do you need Warriors of Light?

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003370_ELIDIBUS
368.description: What, am I to reveal my plans simply because you asked?

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003380_ELIDIBUS
369.description: Nay, I think not─though the stars I acknowledge mine. A convenient illusion apt to awaken what little is left of the power that once resided in your sundered souls.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003390_ELIDIBUS
370.description: That which you and yours call the Echo.

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003400_ELIDIBUS
371.description: And an echo it is. Of a symphony. But a fraction of what men, in their completeness, once possessed.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003410_ELIDIBUS
372.description: Even those among you who tower over others in the gift have only the faintest trace of it.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003420_ELIDIBUS
373.description: But though sundered and forgotten, through death and mocking rebirth, it has persisted. A whisper of our past, burned into your very aether─along with the sight of our end.

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003430_ELIDIBUS
374.description: Through the rekindling of memory, I have awoken the ability─just as Hydaelyn is wont to do when She has need of new minions.

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003440_URIANGER
375.description: The Echo hath ever been thought a gift from Hydaelyn─a boon granted solely to Her chosen. Yet thou wouldst claim She merely awakeneth the power, that men should hearken unto...?

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003460_URIANGER
377.description: ...Her voice. Given the perceived simultaneity of Her call and the awakening of Her chosen's capacity to hear it, 'tis only natural that we thus attributed the source of the gift. Yet if, in truth, the Echo is a prerequisite for hearing Her voice...

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003470_URIANGER
378.description: One might surmise that Her call never ceaseth, such that all who awaken to their innate gift might receive of the blessing of Light at the selfsame instant.

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003480_URIANGER
379.description: In sooth, we bore witness to this but moments ago. At the sight of the starshower, full many in the crowd did speak of hearing a voice in their minds, did they not?

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003490_ELIDIBUS
380.description: Just so. And whenever Hydaelyn has need of new servants, She is quick to pluck comets from the heavens, or create illusions of the same.

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003500_URIANGER
381.description: Why, then, didst thou conjure this vision, full knowing that thine age-old foe would thus claim those awakened to the gift?

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003510_ELIDIBUS
382.description: “Foe”? You must be mistaken. As you see, I am a Warrior of Light.

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003520_ELIDIBUS
383.description: And together with my comrades-in-arms, I shall save the world. Just like you.

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003530_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
384.description: Meanwhile, in the Crystal Tower's Umbilicus...

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003550_MYSTERYVOICE
386.description: If I cannot imbue the infernal thing with my power via magical means, we may need to devise a way to infuse the vessel with my blood after all...

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003580_BEQLUGG
389.description: Perhaps a brief respite? It wouldn't do to overtax yourself.

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003600_MYSTERYVOICE
391.description: And given to stubbornness, I'm afraid. Especially when I have a stake in the outcome.

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003630_MYSTERIOUSCOOPERATOR
394.description: A recurring dream? They do so fascinate me. Might I trouble you for the details?

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003640_ZENOS
395.description: I have always dreamed of it... Fire falling from the heavens, and the city─nay, the whole world ablaze.

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003650_MYSTERIOUSCOOPERATOR
396.description: Indeed... Could Emet-Selch have found a way...? Precious few possess memories of the Final Days.

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003670_MYSTERIOUSCOOPERATOR
398.description: Why yes. Admittedly, my knowledge is mostly secondhand, but if you are interested, I will gladly tell you the tale...

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05200_003680_MYSTERIOUSCOOPERATOR
399.description: The tale of the world's end.
